messages.MESSAGE: Well I am glad to see Cordone has survived frontiership so far. I quite like the "relative" peacefulness here.

[quote=panzovia;59997895]Well I am glad to see Cordone has survived frontiership so far. I quite like the "relative" peacefulness here.[/quote]
Luckily, our chances for surivival go up the longer we last

[spoiler=[b]In the Skies[/b]]

Arenese jamming would have little effect on the continuity of military communications. Constant frequency changing would allow the Reichswehr to continue to coordinate its operations in the south. The fishermen wouldnt be needed to find the Arenese surface fleet, OTH radar had tracked the group of ships from since they were 3,500 km out by pinging off the ionosphere. Satellites would allow the Reichswehr to constantly track the speed, movement and composition of the enemy fleet as well. 

The group of aircraft and UAVs would meet heavy fire. Wächterschild anti-air systems would open up on the group of UAVs and aircraft. Rakete LRS-47 interceptors would be shot into the sky at mach 3.5 to intercept the group of aircraft and UAVs. These missiles use built in radar to track their targets, allowing them to chase down even maneuvering targets at high speeds. On top of this CEC guides the missiles. Radars from a wide variety of assetsaircraft, ships, ground based and others will constantly feed data into the missiles allowing it to fire without seeing the target directly. CEC and on-board radars allow it to lock onto the target and continue to chase even when decoys, maneuvering or other tactics are employed. Infrared seekers onboard also allow the missile to track the heat coming off the engines of the aircraft as well as its onboard systems. 

Rakete LRS-47 also comes with its own full suite of electronic countermeasures. Home-on-jam capabilities allow the missile to detect the site of the jamming and home onto it if operators wish to do so. Discrimination software also allows the the Rakete LRS-47 to continue to track down targets even if spoofing is employed. Constant frequency changes as well help to mitigate the effect of jamming from the enemy. 

On top of the Raketes the air wing already running combat patrols over the south while bombing Bobians would move to deal with the enemy aircraft. The J-15E air superiority aircraft fire their arsenals of Gunslinger air-to-air missiles towards the enemy aircraft and UAVs at before-visual range. EK-18s in the strike package would employ their electronic warfare capabilites on the Arenese aircraft. The Arenese appeared to believe that three separate broadcasting systems would be harder to jam but this just wouldnt be true. Jammer pods on the J-16CJ aircraft would flood the frequencies used by the Arenese with powerful radio signals such that the real signal wouldnt be able to get through. 

EK-18s would employ their spoofing arsenal to transmit fake radar echoes and fake communication signals to create fake targets as well as to mislead speed and guidance. Jamming barrages would also be employed where a broad spectrum of signals in the area would be jammed to deal with the tactic of using multiple signals. However, this wouldnt be the only card up the Reichswehrs sleeve. Digital radio frequency memory or DRFM would be utilized. The EK-18s would record incoming radar signals, alter them and send them back with false info. The purpose of this would be to create fake target signals as well as fake target distance and obscure the vital data needed in modern warfare. 

Finally the next step would be to blind the Arenese eyes and put a hold to the spiders. The satellites required to carry out reconnaissance as well as to implement the Arenese wave system would be targeted. Direct ascent satellites would be fired towards the satellites from the TKS Graf Sachsen carrier strike group. Himmelsbrecher-1 missiles would be launched from guided missile cruisers into the skies. Using infrared tracking along with CEC to track the satellites with deadly precision the weapons would use kinetic force to slam into satellites at 10 km/s. High energy lasers would also be used with the intent of destroying both electro-optical and IR surveillance systems.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]In the Seas[/b]]

THEP would make the blunder yet again of coming infeasbily close to the Kaiserreichs coastline. Squadron A had for some reason placed itself within the range of mines, coastal defences, the blockading fleet, aircraft, drones, along with limiting its own maneuvering. 

Suppression of enemy air defences would come first. TK-300 drones would be sent toward the enemy fleet. These decoys mimic the radar signature of aircraft, meant to drain the enemies interceptors. However, they would serve another purpose as well. Their built-in jamming systems would help wreak havoc through barrage jamming and covering a large group of frequencies. Along with the TK-300s the Harpy drones follow as well. These loitering munition drones stay low to avoid radar detection. Completely autonomous these systems are completely protected from jamming. Once they reach radar emissions they dive down and slam the enemies radars to blind their interceptors. J-16CJs at before-visual range launch their REG-3000 anti-radiation missiles towards the enemy fleet at the same time. These missiles, equipped with LOAL, are launched towards the enemies radars by honing onto their radar emissions. Blitzgeist-99 missiles using CEC would be slammed towards the enemy fleet. Their EMP capabilities would help to fry the enemies electronics, computer systems, communications, radars and guidance systems. 

Seeschlange missiles, part of the Kaiserreichs coastal defences would be used as well. The missiles, stay low to the sea and skim over the water to avoid radar detection. Its CEC capabilities along with frequency hopping would help to nullify Arenese EW. Interceptors would have a hard time preventing the missiles from attacking the surface craft due to the missiles being able to maneuver to avoid the enemy interceptors. Upon getting close to enemy radar the missiles would deploy their chaff releasing clouds of decoys to put false targets to misguide enemy interceptors. DF-26B anti-naval ballistic missiles would be utilized as well. The missile, which reenters at mach 8 would be designed specifically to target Arenese capital ships. Its high speed, maneuverability, chaff, and MIRV capabilities would drastically reduce the chances of interception. 

Under water, the Arenese decision to move to shallow waters near the coast would play into the Kaiserreichs hand. Underwater autonomous vehicles, miniature autonomous submarines, would lurk underwater while launching torpedoes towards the enemy fleet. Mines layed by the Reichswehr and Ekpatanus would come into play as well. These mines, laying on the seabed, would wait until enemy surface craft and submarines came into range. Then they would launch their payloads of torpedoes to sink the enemy craft.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Air and Seapower[/b]]

Hydronian use of drones to counter cruise missiles was ludicrous. All cruise missiles would easily bypass the drones on their way to the jets, runways and aviation fuels. This would be because of a couple reasons. Even with propulsion systems drones would inevitably be slower than the 900 km/h the Donnerkeils would be moving at making crashing into them near impossible. On top of this, with the low altitude flying radar detection would be out of play. Optical would be near impossible with the vastly slower drones having to identify and persecute the missiles within miliseconds which would be impossible. Jamming, lasers and chaff would have little to no effect on the missiles. The CEC system allows the cruise missiles to access a wide variety of inputs to guide itself. On top of its radar it could use datalinks from aircraft, ships, UAVs and ground based systems to guide. Its multiple data inputs would maintain its deadly accuracy. The jamming itself wouldnt hamper the missiles as they hopped frequencies to avoid the jamming. The small, fast and low-flying missiles would prove to outmatch the drones significantly. 

Homing systems wouldnt likely help the Hydronian drones hit the loitering drones as they speed towards the south. Low-flying makes radar out of the question. The drones barely give off an infrared signature due to their advanced cooling system and signal tracing is impossible as they are fire and forget. 

The Hydronian decoys, stripped down versions of their original anti-air systems wouldnt prove effective against the REG-3000s. Radar signal fingerprinting would aid the Reichswehrs ARMs to identify the fake from legitimate AAs. Stripped down versions wouldnt have the same GHz frequencies, pulse repititions, modules and antenna scan patterns as the real versions. A functional anti-air system and a decoy would have inherently different fingerprints and when compared to previous REG-3000 mission data the difference would be jarring. Before firing the differences would become very obvious to not just the J-16CJs but the rest of the strike group and the CSG. When the real systemswith the correct fingerprints came online to respond to the J-16s the payloads would be let loose. Rounds of REG-3000s would speed with deadly accuracy towards the real Hydronian anti-air, ready to destroy the final remnants of any semblance of Hydronian air power. 

There would be significant distance between the J-16CJs and the enemy missiles. A maximum range of 300 kilometres for the REG-3000s allowed the J-16CJs and their strike packages to maintain significant distance. Sending missiles reaching mach 6 would be a ridiculous move for the Hydronians. These types of highly expensive missiles often in the tens of millions arent effective at intercepting aircraft at all. The turning radius for the missiles is massive due to the massive g forces applied to the projectile. The J-16s, small, fast, and agile simply move out of the way of the missiles. 

Hydronia continues to play into the Kaiserreichs hands in naval warfare. Moving submarines so insanely close to the carrier strike group is another win for the Kaiserliche Marine. Passive and active sonar at that range paint massive targets on the backs of the submarines. The missiles aboard the LANCELOT-AR systems have several methods of avoiding ATTs. Deep dives and course shifts are used to throw off tracking systems. Using ultra-quiet electric drives and wake homing the torpedoes are extremely stealthy to bypass the ATTs. Near the fleet, the Kaiserreich has an overwhelming firepower advantage. The full array of submarines, UUVs, surface craft and seabed mines fire torpedoes towards the enemy. 

The Hydronian sprint to reestablish air and naval superiority would be a stumble at best.[/spoiler] 

[spoiler=[b]Pushing the Frontline[/b]]

Activation of the radars on the islands would prompt a fast response. A strike package would quickly take off from the TKS Graf Bismarck and launch its REG-3000 missiles towards the radar signals using INS to continue to track even if they were turned off. 

Using magnetic fields to detect the amphibious landing ships would be a mistake. Degaussing methods, implemented since the 1990s would involve installing electromagnetic coils along the hull to disguise the change in magnetic fields. Most of the craft would be able to move safely to the beachhead but an LCAC would be struck. 

An infantry charge by the Hydronians would be met with brutal Kaiserreich steel. The AAVs that the Reichswehr would move onto the beach using would use their 155 mm autocannons to gun down the men with explosive rounds. The machine guns and grenades would have little effect on the armored vehicles as they continued to move forward and gun down Hydronian personnel. From the air, the cavalry would arrive. Schlange-5 attack helicopters would lay down fire for the expeditionary units, launching rockets and missiles into the lines of charging Hydronians. From the skies the Hydronians would recognize an unmistakable engine sound. The Rhino A-20 designed for close air support would move to gun down the personnel. Armed with a 30 mm GAU-23 cannon, precision guided bombs, small diametre bombs and hellfires it would be perfect for engaging the personnel and armored vehicles. 

By midday the Reichswehr had managed to bring in 30,000 men made up of six Marineinfantriekorps Expeditionary Units. Constant movement of helicopters, LCACs and other amphibious craft would maintain a constant flow of men onto the beachead. From here the heavy armor would advance further into Hydronia. Overwhelming air support including from J-16s would allow them to pummel resistance with JDAMs, cluster munitions and anti-armor weaponry.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Protecting the skies and seas[/b]]
With the drones failing to do any damage, the Hydronians would retire that tactic. The  orange squadron of Xhawk-5s would be deployed from an airbase further east. Whilst the J-16CJs were away in the south, the squadron had a clear shot at taking down the Donnerkeil missiles. Flying from above would allow them to see the missiles despite their attempts at staying low and masking into the terrain. Hydronias very flat terrain would also help make finding the missiles easier. Once located, the squadron fired rounds of air-to-air interceptor missiles towards the Donnerkeils.

Different missiles would be used to deal with the drones. Again, high altitude would allow the jets to locate the drones much easier. These missiles would be smaller, more agile and more accurate, perfect for taking out drones. First a larger missile descended. Once within proximity of the drones, this missile would split into the smaller warheads previously described. The missiles would be able to lock onto the drones and keep an accurate course towards them via very sensitive acoustic sensors, which could pick up on the sounds of drones propellers and other parts.

The Hydronians anti-air may be destroyed, but not before the missiles had been launched. It may appear a stupid design to hurl them at Mach 6 towards the jets, but they had a neat trick up their sleeves. As the missiles rapidly approach their target, they rapidly decelerate to allow them more accurate movement. The missiles use this strategy to quickly gain ground on their target, whilst also retaining accuracy to hit. The J-16CJs move out of the way prematurely, allowing the missiles to slow down and adjust their course to continue speeding towards the jets. Another feature of this missile is its ability to accelerate again, meaning that the jets could never escape.

The ATTs had failed, but all was not lost. The Submarines, first split up to target as many Kaiserreich ships as possible. They employed jamming devices to disrupt the enemys sonar and torpedoes. The submarines also began taking erratic, quick movements to confuse the homing systems of the torpedoes and throw them off the submarines trails. The submarines would then continue to pummel torpedoes into the fleet, this time staying at deeper depths to avoid detection.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler= [b]Pushing back[/b]]
The radar spotted the REG-3000 in an instant. By now, the Hydronians expected it. Microwave technology and spoofing signals would be used simultaneously to throw off the missiles. Even if this failed, the radar had already done its job and alerted the Hydronians to the Kaiserreichs presence.

Magnetic fields werent the only activation mechanism embedded into the mines. A secondary activation system making use of pressure sensors to detect a change in water pressure served as a backup in case of circumstances like these. As the ships moved through the water, the pressure sensors were set off, triggering a chain reaction through the water.

The Hydronians quickly realised that sending men onto the beach would cause nothing but unnecessary bloodshed. Unlike the Kaiserreich, Hydronia doesnt make a habit of committing war crimes. The men were ordered to retreat, but with little success. No more men were sent into the beach and instead, grenades and machine guns were rained down on the Kaiserreich from the hillside. The Kaiserreich had picked a bad location for landing. Eastern Hydronia is the hilliest region of the country and as such, it provided snipers and machine gunners a perfect opportunity. They began targeting the waves of men running onto the beach.

Hydronia would begin attempting to take down the LCACs using some form of Guerilla tactics. Small teams would sneak round hills and onto the beach to deal with the vehicles using anti-ship weapons and firing upon the soldiers inside them, before retreating back up and behind the hills upon neutralising the enemy.

Other armoured vehicles would be dealt with using Hydronias firework-3400 man portable missile launchers. These would be set up on top of the hills and targeted at the array of vehicles, openly visible on the beach and the Rhino A-20 now moving into position above the Hydronians.

Earlier deployed jets from the eastern airbase also flew towards the landing site. Taking the Kaiserreich by surprise, they would quickly open fire on the unsuspecting J-16s. Air-to-air missiles would fire towards them at high speeds, giving them little time to react. Despite this, the Hydronians also began taking heavy losses in their valiant effort to defend their soil.
[/spoiler]
